name: Kitten Island
description: In a world filled with thrilling challenges, hidden secrets, and plenty of meows, take control of an extraordinary kitten on a daring journey! Break blocks, leap over adorable creatures, dodge perilous spikes, and conquer one level after another. Explore vibrant and ever-changing environments—from lush green forests to icy glaciers and blazing deserts. Every jump brings you closer to victory!
